1.consolidated_definition: Pieza acolchada que se pone a los bueyes sobre la frente para protegerlos al ajustarse las coyundas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Pillow-like piece placed on the forehead of oxen to protect them when the yokes are adjusted.
